place.name: Cusco
place.description: Cusco or Cuzco (; Latin American Spanish: [ˈkusko]; Quechua: Qusqu/Qosqo [ˈqosqɔ]) is a city in southeastern Peru, near the Sacred Valley of the Andes mountain range, and the Huatanay and Urubamba rivers. It is the capital and largest city of the eponymous Cusco Province and Cusco Department.
